topic: Compilation of funniest footballer impressions performed in front of the actual players (Nost FC)
hero: Various interviewees and presenters (impression of Mourinho, Micah Richards, Giggs doing Beckham, Haaland doing Stones, CBS segment with Zava/Zlatan card)
hook: Man in armchair with subtitle about a Jose Mourinho-style voice
subtitle_style: White bold uppercase caption on black strip, bottom centre, often wrapped in asterisks; small 'Nost FC' watermark bottom-centre
reaction_overlays: none besides captions and watermark; CBS Mornings lower third from source clip
transition_summary: Short TV/interview clips, hard cuts about 1 per 2-3 s (30 cuts in 64 s), caption per clip
audio_note: Original interview/TV speech and laughter; transcript starts with a man explaining his impersonation

reuse_segments.what: Interview/TV clips of players doing impressions
reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: needs licensed TV/interview rights; recreate with original impressions or generated footage
